name: roman_numeral
description: Arabic-to-Roman numeral conversion, with numeric extraction control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
def roman(n):
 s=''
 for v,t in [(10,'X'),(9,'IX'),(5,'V'),(4,'IV'),(1,'I')]:
  while n>=v: s+=t;n-=v
 return s
items=[]; controls=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=i%20+1; obj=random.choice(['chapter','volume','section','part','book'])
 stem=f'The {obj} number is {n}. '
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'Written as an uppercase Roman numeral, it is','answer':' '+roman(n)})
 controls.append({'prompt':stem+'Written in Arabic digits, it is','answer':' '+str(n)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
